Alex K: Hi team — just married last week! Trying to add my spouse to medical and dental. Open enrollment already closed; what are my options?
Maria S: Congrats!! :tada: You have 30 days to add via qualifying life event. Submit marriage cert + benefits change form.
Alex K: Thanks. Is payroll deduction retroactive to last pay period or next month?
Linda (Benefits): Hi Alex — congrats. Deductions start the next payroll after we process the change unless you elect retroactive coverage; retro pay will be prorated if requested.
Alex K: How do I request retroactive coverage?
Linda (Benefits): Attach a copy of marriage certificate and include desired effective date on the benefits change form. We can backdate to the marriage date if within 30 days. Use portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/changes
Alex K: Got it. Any docs for spouse ID? They don't have SSN yet.
Jamal R: If spouse is international w/out SSN, we can still enroll but need ITIN or passport + proof of address; Linda will confirm.
Linda (Benefits): Yep — passport + proof of address works. If no SSN/ITIN, we put 'pending' until missing info. Send scanned docs to benefits@redwood.com (secure upload preferred).
Alex K: Cool. One more — does adding spouse affect HSA eligibility if we switch plans?
Maria S: Good Q. HSA eligibility depends on plan type and whether spouse has other coverage. If you enroll in an HSA-eligible plan for family, you can contribute family limits. Contact benefits for specifics.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: QLE docs must be uploaded within 30 days to avoid denial. See FAQ: https://docs.redwood.example/benefits/qle
Alex K: Thanks everyone. I'll upload docs today.
Linda (Benefits): I'll confirm once received and send payroll update. :ok_hand: 
Alex K: Appreciate it! :heart:
